Corporate Event

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Coordinate executive arrivals, conference movements, client dinners, and team events around one documented transportation plan.

Prices start at $145 an hour for the Executive Black Sprinter, which seats 14, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $580 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

From four executives to 2,000–3,000 guests

The biggest single vehicle we run is the 56-Passenger Motorcoach — 56 seats, one chauffeur, one door. Below it sit party buses, mini buses, Executive Sprinters and a luxury Suburban, so a four-person board run and a 56-seat shuttle are the same booking with a different vehicle on it.

Above 56 the answer is arithmetic, not a different company: we book the fleet in multiples and coordinate it. On that footing a corporate or event program runs to 2,000–3,000 guests — conference shuttles, incentive trips, multi-day event transport — on one reservation, one schedule and one contact at the desk who owns it.

Give us a headcount and a schedule and we will tell you how many vehicles it takes, in writing, before anything is charged.

Frequently asked questions

Can you handle multi-day corporate events?

Submit the complete multi-day schedule, passenger counts, contacts, and route requirements. The team will review availability and state any accepted vehicle assignments and coordination scope in writing.

Do you provide airport meet & greet?

When meet-and-greet is included, the written confirmation states the terminal meeting point, wait-time allowance, and contact procedure.

Can you invoice our company?

Corporate billing requirements are reviewed during booking and any approved invoicing terms are stated in writing.
